subject.title: fix #95295: [Bug]: Web UI sidebar hides existing child-spawned subagent sessions across agent scopes

question: Should the Control UI sidebar offer a default-off “All agents” mode that exposes persisted child sessions across configured agent scopes?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but the intended visibility boundary between configured agent scopes is a product decision that repository history and tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve sidebar-only opt-in
options.body: Allow explicit cross-agent discovery while preserving the default scoped result and leaving other session surfaces unchanged.

options.title: Keep agent scopes isolated
options.body: Do not expose persisted child sessions from other configured agents in the sidebar.

options.title: Unify session-surface UX first
options.body: Hold the PR until the sidebar and Sessions page share one clearly labeled all-agent interaction model.

recommendation.title: Approve sidebar-only opt-in
recommendation.body: Allow explicit cross-agent discovery while preserving the default scoped result and leaving other session surfaces unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current sidebar/session navigation architecture that defines the visibility behavior being changed.
